name: telinha-cafe-mobile
description: Telinha Café para Android (Capacitor) — usa a mesma interface do app de PC

scripts.build:web: node build-web.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run build:web && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.apk:debug: npm run build:web && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
